title: A CI run where every job skipped does not count as green for a merge
why: When every job skips, the all-jobs-passed rollup skips too and GitHub counts it as passing, so a batch with no checks run reads green (q_max #1158, 23:28 CST Nov 11).
source: coordinator 23:27 CST Nov 11, from batch runner 11; incident q_max #1158
note: Find where to refuse it: the shared all-jobs-passed action, or merge.py's read of the required check. Then check every child repo's checks.yml for the same branch filter (step qmax-ci-batch-heads fixes q_max's). A real incident, so a step, not a note. Lane started 23:28 CST Nov 11 (coordinator), stability fix under the owner 13:51 CST grant; it stays out of hooks/test_guard.py until the guard test split lands. Closed with no change (coordinator 23:33 CST Nov 11). Done check green on main: 6892e6419 merge/merge.py refuses an all-skipped head ("no check ran on this head", "skipped, no job ran") since Nov 4; the lane replayed q_max #1158 and got red every time. The false green was the host's own mergeable_state, since q_max main has no branch protection (step main-protection-ruleset-text covers it). Only q_max skips on batch-* heads (step qmax-ci-batch-heads).
